question: Estimate the number of cell towers Jio needs to cover India.
idealClarificationQuestions: All technologies: 4G + 5G + fiber-related sites? Cell towers (RAN sites).
Existing Jio infrastructure? Yes — total deployed.
Including indoor small cells? Macro towers primarily.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Population × tower density per user OR area × tower density per sq km.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Urban area in India: ~100K sq km × 3 = 300K towers.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Total tower-shareable infra needed: ~1.15M tower-locations pan-India.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Jio publicly disclosed ~3.5L sites and 5G NSA across 7L+ small cells.

benchmarkAssumptions.value: urban dense ~3 towers/sq km, suburban ~1/sq km, rural ~0.3/sq km.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Jio's share of telecom market (~40% subs)
benchmarkAssumptions.value: Jio has ~600K-700K BTS sites including 5G. Towers (shared infrastructure with Indus Towers, ATC etc.) ~250K-350K physical Jio-anchored.

calculationFlow: Urban area in India: ~100K sq km × 3 = 300K towers.
Suburban + small towns: ~400K sq km × 1 = 400K towers.
Jio publicly disclosed ~3.5L sites and 5G NSA across 7L+ small cells.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Jio publicly disclosed ~3.5L sites and 5G NSA across 7L+ small cells.
